research.title: Preprocessing and Baseline Evaluation for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and TF-IDF feature extraction steps for classifying support requests under an existing experimental protocol.
Ran specified logistic regression experiments and organized misclassified examples by request category for review during research group discussions.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against purchase orders, and reported discrepancies to the responsible staff.
Prepared routine order paperwork, coordinated collection schedules, and followed up on outstanding documentation with suppliers and internal teams.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Product Review Sentiment
bullets: Implemented count-based text features and a multinomial naive Bayes classifier in scikit-learn to predict sentiment labels for product reviews.
Compared unigram and bigram feature configurations on a held-out split, inspecting classification errors involving negation and mixed sentiment.
